name: privacy-browser-agent
description: PRIVIS: On-device Visual Perception for Light-weight Browser Agents

scripts.build: node scripts/copy-ort-assets.mjs && esbuild background/service-worker.ts content/capture-content.ts privacy/engine/vision/ort-runtime.ts privacy/engine/vision/face-detector.ts privacy/engine/vision/face-pipeline.ts privacy/engine/fuse.ts --bundle --format=iife --loader:.md=text --outdir=dist && esbuild extension/src/popup/popup.ts --bundle --format=iife --loader:.md=text --outfile=dist/popup/popup.js && esbuild extension/src/offscreen/offscreen.ts --bundle --format=iife --loader:.md=text --outfile=dist/offscreen/offscreen.js
scripts.test:vision: npm run build && esbuild privacy/engine/vision/test-ort-runtime.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist-test/test-ort-runtime.mjs && node dist-test/test-ort-runtime.mjs
scripts.test:face: npm run build && esbuild privacy/engine/vision/test-face-detector.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist-test/test-face-detector.mjs && node dist-test/test-face-detector.mjs
scripts.test:face-pipeline: npm run build && esbuild privacy/engine/vision/test-face-pipeline.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist-test/test-face-pipeline.mjs && node dist-test/test-face-pipeline.mjs
scripts.test:privacy: npm run build && esbuild privacy/engine/vision/test-privacy-boundary.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --loader:.md=text --outfile=dist-test/test-privacy-boundary.mjs && node dist-test/test-privacy-boundary.mjs
scripts.test:transparency: esbuild tests/test-transparency-purity.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --loader:.md=text --outfile=dist-test/test-transparency-purity.mjs && node dist-test/test-transparency-purity.mjs && esbuild tests/test-transparency-buffer.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --loader:.md=text --outfile=dist-test/test-transparency-buffer.mjs && node dist-test/test-transparency-buffer.mjs && esbuild tests/test-transparency-digest.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --loader:.md=text --outfile=dist-test/test-transparency-digest.mjs && node dist-test/test-transparency-digest.mjs
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:cba && npm run test:navigate && npm run test:router && npm run test:guard && npm run test:privacy && npm run test:privacy-contract && npm run test:popup && npm run test:loop && npm run test:session-e2e && npm run test:settings && npm run test:goal && npm run test:quota && npm run test:transparency && npm run test:validators && npm run test:lexical && npm run test:detection && npm run test:placeholders && npm run test:gate && npm run test:vault && npm run test:geometry && npm run test:ocr-regions && npm run test:text-chunks && npm run test:format-value && npm run test:goal-tokenize && npm run test:local-intent && npm run test:agent-phase4 && npm run test:vault-phase5 && npm run test:browser-phase6 && npm run test:eval-phase7 && npm run test:release-phase8 && npm run test:chrome-phase9 && npm run test:security-phase10 && npm run test:perf-phase11 && npm run test:ux-phase12 && npm run test:advanced-phase13 && npm run test:vision && npm run test:face && npm run test:face-pipeline
